title: Standing cadences and anchors: the wound register and weekly monitoring
description: These claims keep standing records on a fixed cadence: strike diagnostics at seven-day intervals, the Ruby Moot's wound register kept weekly whether or not a case is pending, and markers of adversarial-by-origin law folded into the same weekly monitoring.
